snippet.title: Raji: Kaliyuga - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Raji fans, we are proud to reveal the first Gameplay Trailer for Raji: Kaliyuga, the sequel to Raji: An Ancient Epic, set six years later. The unsealing of the heavens by the asura warlord Mahabalasura escalates the conflict within the game to a cosmic level. This grand battle encompasses not only mortals but also gods, asuras, and mystical entities.

Raji, now a seasoned warrior, and her dreamwalking brother Darsh journey to the Eternal Summit to save or destroy the universe. Raji: Kaliyuga features dual protagonists: Raji, with acrobatic martial arts and the Trishul, and Darsh, with immense Siddhi powers that control gravity, time, and energy. It introduces customised evasion for Raji and a siddhi-yielding system for Darsh, allowing unique combat styles. 

The game is a third-person action-adventure, with Nodding Heads Games committed to delivering a high-quality experience for Raji and action-adventure genre fans. The gameplay trailer was revealed through the prestigious The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026, a digital showcase event in partnership with Summer Game Fest. The trailer is over 5 minutes and serves as an introduction into the intriguing universe and characters of the Raji universe, leaning into high fidelity, fast paced action.

Wishlist now on Steam, Epic Games, GOG, PlayStation 5, PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4096880/Raji_Kaliyuga/

For more info, visit rajithegame.com

#rajithegame #rajikaliyuga #summergamefest
